headline: 3 layers of a blood vessel wall
stat_note: tunics in every artery and vein
body:
Intima: endothelium lining the lumen
Media: smooth muscle + elastic fibers
Externa: tough collagen outer sheath
Arteries: thick wall, small lumen
Veins: thin wall, large lumen, valves
source: Source: OpenStax Anatomy & Physiology 2e, 20.1 Blood Vessels

headline: Parts of a neuron in order
body:
1. Dendrites: receive signals
2. Cell body: nucleus + organelles
3. Axon hillock: axon starts here
4. Axon + myelin: carries the impulse
5. Terminals: pass it on at the synapse
source: Source: OpenStax Anatomy & Physiology 2e, 12.2 Nervous Tissue
